2026.11.02-playtest.1:
Launcher update test

This build brings the playtest up to the current November 2 project, replacing the October 25 baseline.

Testing focus
• Install the update over your existing installation.
• Confirm the game launches and your settings remain intact.
• Try your student loadouts and report any gameplay or visual issues.

The build passed the editor shader and gameplay checks. Multiplayer and long-session performance still need playtesting.
2026.10.25-baseline: Initial private launcher baseline using the October 25 Windows build. Used to verify account access, installation, and game launching.
2026.11.02-playtest.2:
Private reports and quit-flow update

• Quit Game now defers teardown until after the UI callback and gives network shutdown a bounded grace period.
• Completed multiplayer performance reports upload to the private playtest inbox. Offline or failed deliveries stay queued for retry; quitting never waits for uploads.
• Automatic reporting can be disabled in Settings. Reports include hardware, graphics settings, frame/network metrics and gameplay events, not names, chat, account IDs or invitation keys.
• Fire application icon included.

Validation: shader/gameplay checks, title and active-LAN-host process-exit tests, and a synthetic report uploaded by Unity and downloaded privately with matching bytes passed. Full remote multiplayer playtesting is still needed.
